subject.title: feat: flow dashboard session activity to main agents

question: Should newly created dashboard sessions use an implicit parent link to the routed agent’s main session by default when `session.dmScope` is unset or `main`, accepting the resulting flow-up and session-ownership semantics for existing installations?
rationale: This is a deliberate default behavior change to persisted session metadata rather than a mechanical repair; source tests establish the intended branches but cannot decide whether that default relationship is the desired product contract.

options.title: Approve implicit main parenting
options.body: Adopt the proposed default after live proof confirms dashboard threads remain independently navigable and main-session activity notifications are useful.

options.title: Require opt-in semantics
options.body: Keep dashboard sessions unparented by default and add a separately approved configuration or product path if maintainers want the flow-up relationship.

options.title: Pause for session-model design
options.body: Defer the PR if parent ownership, tree visibility, or watcher semantics need a broader session-model decision first.

recommendation.title: Approve implicit main parenting
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed default after live proof confirms dashboard threads remain independently navigable and main-session activity notifications are useful.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author supplied the concrete parent-link design and compatibility rationale, making them the best available routing candidate from the supplied context.
